sources.authorityRationale: An original-manufacturer engineering application note for energy-metering ICs, opened and read directly page by page. Classified AUTHORITATIVE_TECHNICAL_REFERENCE on the basis of its issued engineering-application-note content stating a general metrological principle (energy = accumulated power over time), consistent with how other manufacturer application notes are classified elsewhere in this corpus (e.g. the DOE engineering handbook), not merely on the publisher's institutional category.

correctionNote: Corrected during the internal adversarial audit pass. Three supportsRequirementSuffixes entries were REMOVED as over-claims -- each asserted that a source supported a requirement on which it was not actually a candidate source (SRC-ETW-INDUCTOR on the inductance UNIT_SYMBOL requirement; SRC-EOLSS-ELECQUANT on the capacitance and inductance DEFINITION requirements). The register now matches the evidence results exactly.

openAuthorityClassificationMatterForProd.resolution: electronics-tutorials.ws (SRC-ETW-*) reclassified AUTHORITATIVE_EDUCATIONAL_REFERENCE. 6 results rebound to the already-registered SRC-EOLSS-ELECQUANT; 2 results (the ohm unit symbol, twice) additionally bound to the already-registered SRC-BIPM-BROCHURE; 11 CONCEPT_DEFINITION-mode results needed no resourcing since that mode already permits AUTHORITATIVE_EDUCATIONAL_REFERENCE; 5 results with no viable already-registered alternative were honestly downgraded to PARTIALLY_VERIFIED rather than left falsely VERIFIED. See COVERAGE-REPORT.md for the full breakdown.

originalConcern.concern: electronics-tutorials.ws (the ten SRC-ETW-* sources) is classified AUTHORITATIVE_TECHNICAL_REFERENCE, and that classification is load-bearing rather than cosmetic.
originalConcern.scale: 22 of this batch's 57 results depend on an SRC-ETW-* source. 16 results have NO non-ETW candidate source at all (resistance UNIT_SYMBOL; power DISTINCTION; energy DISTINCTION; all four power-factor facets; frequency DEFINITION and QUANTITY_SYMBOL; impedance UNIT_SYMBOL; capacitance DEFINITION, DISTINCTION and QUANTITY_SYMBOL; inductance DEFINITION, DISTINCTION and QUANTITY_SYMBOL). A further 6 list a non-ETW candidate but attribute every normalized claim to ETW.
originalConcern.whyItMatters: SYMBOL_OR_CONVENTION requirements in the frozen plan permit only PRIMARY_NORMATIVE_OR_STANDARDS_BODY, PROFESSIONAL_BODY and AUTHORITATIVE_TECHNICAL_REFERENCE -- AUTHORITATIVE_EDUCATIONAL_REFERENCE is excluded. If electronics-tutorials.ws were reclassified as an educational reference (which is the class this same batch assigned to LibreTexts on comparable reasoning), then roughly ten symbol-convention results would fail their permitted-authority gate simultaneously.
originalConcern.counterConsideration: The site is an anonymous commercial tutorial website: no named authors, no editorial board, no citations, no revision history and no errata process. The registered rationale describes it as 'long-established, widely used in technical/vocational electrical education', which is an assertion made by the acquisition rather than an evidenced fact.
originalConcern.sharpestInstance: resistance's UNIT_SYMBOL (the ohm) rests solely on SRC-ETW-DC1, while SRC-BIPM-BROCHURE -- a PRIMARY_NORMATIVE source already registered and already read, whose own registered locator explicitly lists 'electric resistance-ohm' in Table 2 -- was used for the ampere, volt, watt, joule, hertz, farad and henry but not the ohm.
originalConcern.dispositionInThisPass: NOT resolved unilaterally. Reclassifying the site would cascade into roughly ten simultaneous authority-gate failures, and re-sourcing those results is fresh acquisition rather than correction. This is recorded as an explicit matter for Product Architect judgment at the consolidated review, and is NOT counted as a defect corrected.
